name: Edward Medard Conservation Park Campground
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 23, 2026 research.
navigationDestination: 6140 Turkey Creek Road, Plant City, FL 33567
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: All 43 sites have 30-amp power (17 also have 50-amp), water, a picnic table and a fire ring, with restrooms and showers nearby. $24 a night covers up to 8 people with one RV or two tents ($18 for 55 and older).
